top_signals.title: AI Debt Spree Hammers Tech Debt as Traders Rush to Reprice Risk
top_signals.summary: The rush to finance AI is rattling investors in the more than $10 trillion US corporate market, sparking a repricing of risks around some of the biggest technology companies that’s showing up in spiking prices for credit insurance, heightened volatility and weakening preformance.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
